title: Install the dependency set WE chose: one curated pip file, not 13 unconstrained per-node resolves
description: UMBRELLA - absorbs MPI-406 (closed) and the original MPI-413 diagnosis. Scope agreed with the user 2026-07-31, POST-1.3.0. NOT A RELEASE BLOCKER: a CUDA torch runs fine on CPU, so the app installs and generates; the cost is bandwidth, disk and decompression. THE FRAMING: this is the same defect MPI-419 just fixed, one layer down. MPI-419 was "we install an unpinned ComfyUI and hope"; this is "we let each custom node resolve its own requirements on the user machine and hope". Both ship a dependency set nobody chose and no CI ever tested. MECHANISM: downloadManager.js:2181 runs pip install -r <reqs> --upgrade through runPipCommand (shared.js:284), a bare python -m pip with NO index and NO constraint file, so torch resolves from default PyPI = the CUDA build. --upgrade makes it fire even on an already-correct engine; the comment at downloadManager.js:2033 claiming --upgrade is idempotent is wrong. Same mechanism as MPI-217 (opencv 4.13 -> 5.0 across the whole engine). EVIDENCE A (Linux, no NVIDIA driver): one node requirements file pulled torch, triton, cuda-toolkit and 14 nvidia-* wheels, several GB, REPLACING the +cpu torch that comfy install had just placed correctly. Wheel decompression contributed to a thermal shutdown on that box. EVIDENCE B (macOS M4 fresh install 2026-07-31, WARM cache): 13 pip invocations, 400 "Requirement already satisfied" lines, numpy re-resolved 18x, torch 10x, and 4 packages installed then uninstalled and replaced (kornia 0.8.3, transformers 5.14.1, matplotlib 3.11.1, ultralytics 8.4.113). DESIGN Phase 1 - constrain every node pip (constraint file + drop --upgrade). The Pod image ALREADY does this via ENV PIP_CONSTRAINT=/opt/constraints.txt and the local engine does not; that asymmetry IS the bug. runPipCommand is a SHARED primitive - sweep every call site in one pass. Phase 1 also makes most pipPins redundant, since they are a repair for damage it prevents. DESIGN Phase 2 - maintain OUR OWN aggregated, tested pip file versioned alongside dev_configs/node_lock.json, install it in a single pass, and disable every node requirements step. GENERATE it with uv pip compile in CI and curate the diff, so maintenance works like a node bump instead of relying on memory. SAFETY NET ALREADY EXISTS: the Pod image build boots ComfyUI and greps for IMPORT FAILED (MPI-341), so an under-specified aggregate goes red in CI, not on a user machine. OPEN QUESTIONS: only 4 of 7 installRequirements nodes use a plain requirements.txt - ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation ships NONE (its deps live inside install.py; measured on macOS it adds exactly one redundant opencv-contrib-python and a failed cupy build), so read what Impact-Pack and controlnet_aux commands do beyond pip before disabling them. Use PEP 508 markers for platform variance or the darwin sam2 / onnxruntime-gpu drops regress. Constrain against ComfyUI core pins so the aggregate is strictly additive. Decide what repair-deps means once installs are not per-node. Decide the fallback when a merged resolve HARD FAILS where sequential silently succeeded by last-writer-wins. Full detail in brief.md. VERIFY on a CPU-only box: 0 hits for "downloading (triton|nvidia)", torch reports a +cpu tag, already-satisfied count far below 400, zero IMPORT FAILED, Pod image build stays green.
activeSessionTitle: MPI-413 Phase 2 — one curated pip file
